abstract: OBJECTIVE: The clinical characteristics of ovarian tumors associated with pregnancy were investigated. METHOD: A series of 106 cases of ovarian tumor surgically resected during pregnancy was investigated with respect to incidence, clinicopathologic features and outcome. RESULTS: Among 106 cases undergoing ovarian surgery, 31 (29.2%), 70 (66%) and five (4.7%) were diagnosed as physiologic, benign and malignant, respectively. The incidence of benign neoplastic tumor was 1:112 deliveries and that of malignant neoplastic tumor was 1:1684 deliveries. Dermoid cyst was the most common lesion found. Of the 70 benign tumors, 51 (72.9%) were greater than 8 cm in diameter and 55 (78.6%) were preoperatively diagnosed before the 10th gestational week; 44 (62.9%) were operated before the 15th gestational week. The spontaneous abortion rate in 80 cases followed up after surgery was only 10%, 61 patients (76.3%) progressing to full-term delivery. Five malignant tumors included three epithelial carcinomas, one embryonal carcinoma and one dysgerminoma. CONCLUSION: Ovarian surgery in the first trimester for persistent or enlarging masses is important to obtain a final histologic diagnosis and rule out malignancy.
abstract_ja: 目的: 妊娠に関連する卵巣腫瘍の臨床的特徴を検討した。 方法: 妊娠中に手術的に切除された卵巣腫瘍106例を対象に、発生頻度、臨床病理学的特徴、転帰を検討した。 結果: 卵巣手術を受けた106例のうち、31例（29.2%）が生理的、70例（66%）が良性、5例（4.7%）が悪性と診断された。良性腫瘍の発生頻度は分娩112件に1例、悪性腫瘍は分娩1684件に1例であった。類皮嚢腫が最も多い病変であった。良性腫瘍70例のうち、51例（72.9%）は直径8cmを超え、55例（78.6%）は妊娠10週以前に術前診断された。44例（62.9%）は妊娠15週以前に手術が行われた。術後に追跡された80例の自然流産率はわずか10%で、61例（76.3%）が満期分娩に至った。悪性腫瘍5例には、上皮性癌3例、胎児性癌1例、ディスジャーミノーマ1例が含まれた。 結論: 持続性または増大する腫瘤に対しては、妊娠初期に卵巣手術を行い、最終的な組織診断を得て悪性を除外することが重要である。
